title: dioscorea villosa subsp. hirticaulis
intro: Dioscorea villosa subsp. hirticaulis, commonly known as Wild Yam, is a perennial plant native to eastern North America, characterized by its hairy stems and leaves. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include relief from menstrual cramps, menopausal symptoms, and other gynecological issues. The therapeutic actions of Wild Yam are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Wild Yam include diosgenin, a steroid saponin, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
